defects.what: Spike not moved to design/spike/archived/ although this PR finishes its implementation (spike README Lifecycle step 5); design/tracker.md:33 still links the unarchived path.
PrioritiesPageData and DumpPageData live in src/utils/ while the Projects and Board page data types live in src/types/.
The two new route adapters differ in style: toPrioritiesPageProps is an arrow const, toDumpPageProps (and toBoardCards) a function declaration.
A client-safe util imports the MatrixData type from the server-only services layer; allowed as import type, but the type belongs in src/types/.
usePrioritiesPageContext() sits between two useTranslations calls, splitting the hook grouping.
